THE IDEA BEHIND THE MAP

Different scales.
One connected picture.

This explorer adapts the supplied document’s varied-scale topological visualization to geographic records.

  1. Start with a global cover.Overlapping geographic bins group nearby records.
  2. Look for density.The busiest region receives a finer local cover and smaller clustering radius.
  3. Keep the connections.Clusters sharing records are linked, including across global and local views.

The document provides five example cities, not a complete geographic dataset. This app generates 640 sample records around those locations. Import JSON to explore your own data.
